property: the file is RC4-encrypted (standard handler, revision 2) with an empty user password

facts.text: Synthetic structure test document. Every name and number on it is invented.

note: Encrypted by the standard security handler, revision 2 (40-bit RC4), as ISO 32000-1 7.6.3 defines it. The user password is empty and the owner password is the synthetic string 'synthetic-owner-password'. /O: the owner password, padded to 32 bytes with the standard padding string, is hashed with MD5; the first 5 bytes of the hash are an RC4 key that encrypts the padded user password. File key: MD5 over the padded user password, /O, /P as four little-endian bytes and the first /ID string; its first 5 bytes. /U: the padding string encrypted with the file key. Each object: MD5 over the file key, the object number (three little-endian bytes) and the generation (two); its first 10 bytes are the RC4 key for that object's strings and streams. The file was written once with that procedure and is kept as written.
